![A Genos answer with its sources shown as links to a chat, a note and a task](/lp/shots/en/ask.webp)

A confident answer can still be wrong.

Genos AI shows the threads, notes and tasks it drew on as links. Open one and check.

```flow
Ask in plain words
Read the answer
Open the source
```

It searches only what you can already open.
